generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Build experiment code, data processing, instrumentation, environment descriptions, and run scripts.

contract.purpose_user_function: Construct experiment code, data processing, instrumentation, environment descriptions, and run scripts under evidence/approval controls.
contract.valid_inputs: Experiment plan, hypothesis, code/data refs, metrics, environment, seed, runtime allowlist/approval, and output locations.
contract.expected_outputs: Experiment assets, run contract/scripts, instrumentation, environment manifest, and typed plan/result evidence.
contract.state_side_effects: Creates scripts/config/artifacts; actual experiment execution may consume compute or remote resources only when approved.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Missing plan/approval/runtime, invalid metric/data, unsafe side effect, environment failure, or unsupported provider yields blocked/inconclusive evidence.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: AutoSci experiment workflows and skills are shipped; domain-specific experiment construction is delegated to operators.
contract.success_evidence: Assets are runnable/reproducible, plan/result schemas validate, and side effects occur only with approval/runtime evidence.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: local dry run; approved execution; missing approval; reproducibility; instrumentation; failed environment; result schema.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md §Basic Workflow and Appendix AutoSci Commands; docs/WORKFLOW_DESIGN.md Phases 2-5; AGENTS.md Scope and Local Workflow
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: Builder work is dispatched through harness/lib/operator_runtime.py and physical operators; task-specific interfaces include .agents/skills/exp-run/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-draft/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-compile/SKILL.md, skills/test/SKILL.md
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Solar ships primarily as a Claude Code overlay. Concrete builds depend on selected physical operators, language toolchains, credentials, datasets, hardware, and approval/write-scope policy.

implementation.interfaces: Builder work is dispatched through harness/lib/operator_runtime.py and physical operators; task-specific interfaces include .agents/skills/exp-run/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-draft/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-compile/SKILL.md, skills/test/SKILL.md
